description.value:
Canon gives Grimmjow no Segunda Etapa — Ulquiorra is explicitly the only Espada who reached one. The technique Desgarrón is canon and appears where canon puts it, at his Final Release. This second released form is invented, and is deliberately the least transformative of the five Hollow entries for that reason.

Your Speed increases by another 10 feet, and your claws gain deadly d10. Once per round when you critically hit with a claw, you may immediately make an additional claw Strike against the same target at your current multiple attack penalty.

Additionally, Garra de la Pantera's cone increases to 60 feet, and creatures that critically fail against it take 2d6 persistent bleed from embedded shards.
